title: Swap Stone and Deepslate
description: Swaps stone and deepslate. Deepslate now spawns at Y>0 and stone now spawns at Y<0.
body:
Swaps stone and deepslate spawning. Extends to ores spawned.

Vanilla:
+Y <- Stone <- Y=0 -> Deepslate -> -Y

Swap Stone and Deepslate:
+Y <- Deepslate <- Y=0 -> Stone -> -Y

That's it. Really simple.
